description: Straight stairs climbing along +Z: a solid concrete flight (one watertight sawtooth solid) or open wooden treads between two stringers, with optional handrails on both sides. Pivot at the bottom of the first step, centred in width. Pieces: stairs_flight (concrete) or stairs_treads (wood) + stairs_stringers (wood_dark), stairs_railing (metal_dark).

style.desc: solid concrete flight or open treads on stringers

railing.desc: handrails with posts on both sides

profile.note: sawtooth side profile in the ZY plane (x = 0)

params.code:
const n = Math.round(steps), r = rise, d = run;
for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const q = addpoint(0, [0, (i + 1) * r - 0.025, i * d + d / 2]); setpointattrib(0, 'scale', q, [width - 0.1, 0.05, d + 0.02]); setpointattrib(0, 'tint', q, 0.85 + 0.25 * rand(i, 3)); }

stringer_profile.note: board under the tread ends: top edge through the tread noses, 0.3 m deep, cut at the ground

post_pts.note: posts every third step and at the top, on both sides; the rail runs through their tops

params.code: const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (!m) return; const k = haspointattrib(0, 'tint') ? point(0, 'tint', primpoints(0, @primnum)[0]) || 1 : 1; @Cd = mul(m.baseColor, k);
